title: Server configuration
description: The process environment the boardgame.io server reads. Two knobs; neither is owed by an environment.

PORT.description: Listen port. Defaults to 8000 in code and is 8080 in production; both probes target whatever this resolves to.

CLIENT_ORIGIN.description: One origin added to the socket handshake allowlist. Not required: localhost and 127.0.0.1 are admitted on any port already.
